chunks: From him, from Fudayla, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
"When distraction becomes frequent for you, continue with your prayer, for it will soon leave you; it is merely from Satan."
ai.seo_question: What should one do if they feel frequently distracted during Islamic prayer?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) instructs believers to persist in prayer despite frequent distractions (*sahw*), noting that the phenomenon is typically a tactic of Satan (*waswas*) that will naturally subside. This ruling emphasizes the validity of prayer despite minor lapses in concentration, distinguishing between mere distraction and a complete break in the prayer's continuity, a key distinction in Shia fiqh.
